title: Design QA website screenshot export
description: Update the design-QA renderer to export every screen at one website-ready size, place tabs on top, render transparent macOS-style window chrome with traffic lights, emit a matching chrome mask, use bronze as the default accent, generate outputs locally, and verify the full repository gate.
close_reason: Replaced broken website exports with isolated coherent screens at 2x retina resolution and locked medium spacing.

title: Disable unused Chromium on-device ML startup probe
description: The macOS development bundle starts successfully but Chromium 150 logs services/on_device_model/ml/gpu_blocklist.cc errors because its optional on-device model subsystem probes for a GPU adapter. GhostSHELL does not use Chromium on-device models.
acceptance_criteria: GhostSHELL explicitly disables the correct Chromium on-device model feature(s) before CEF initialization without reducing browser renderer diagnostics globally. The development launch emits no gpu_blocklist Unable to get gpu adapter errors. Focused tests and the full repository gate pass.
close_reason: Disabled Chromium 150's unused OptimizationGuideOnDeviceModel feature; focused tests, exact macOS launch observation, and full gate pass.

title: Close remaining native and dependency security-validation blindspots
description: The instrumental audit completed with Semgrep, Gitleaks, OSV, Grype, Syft, Bandit, ShellCheck, Checkov, and offline Trivy, but Dependency-Check/NVD was unavailable and native packaged behavior remains partly inferred. Add a repeatable current-NVD dependency scan plus disposable packaged canaries for CEF incognito storage/restricted preview behavior, terminal native notification byte limits, and cross-platform link/ownership guards.
acceptance_criteria: A documented reproducible lane runs against a current NVD source, accounts for every advisory, and executes packaged macOS/Linux/Windows security canaries without persistent user data or network side effects; results are integrated into the repository gate or a required CI security gate.

title: Do not access provider credentials during fresh startup
description: Fresh GhostSHELL startup currently enumerates macOS Keychain metadata from MainWindowViewModel construction and restored AI-provider selection eagerly discovers models, which resolves the stored OAuth session. macOS may prompt for the login Keychain password before the user requests AI or Secrets access.
acceptance_criteria: Constructing MainWindowViewModel performs no secret metadata enumeration. Constructing/restoring AgentChatViewModel performs no model discovery or OAuth credential read. Explicit Secrets/MCP navigation and Refresh models retain their current behavior. Focused tests and the full repository gate pass.
notes: Fixed by deferring native secret metadata enumeration to explicit Secrets/MCP navigation and deferring provider model discovery to the explicit Refresh models action. Focused App regression set passed 125/125; ./scripts/check.sh --full passed on 2026-08-20.

title: Toggle Process Monitor sort direction and pad headers
description: Add File Viewer-style header padding and make repeated Process Monitor header clicks request the opposite source sort while keeping the governed agent sort contract unchanged.

title: Bind governed browser navigation to the verified connection peer
description: SEC-005 remains partially open after origin binding and private-address admission. The application resolves and approves a hostname, but Chromium independently resolves/selects the actual peer after CEF Continue(); SSH-routed browsing also lacks equivalent remote-side destination attestation. Implement a connection path that binds the approved hostname to an admitted peer while preserving TLS hostname validation, plus an equivalent remote policy.
acceptance_criteria: A controlled rebinding test with approved and private listeners proves the private listener receives no connection; local and SSH-routed navigation enforce equivalent destination policy; all existing browser policy tests and the full repository gate pass.

title: Restore native image and PDF previews through killable bounded workers
description: SEC-011 and SEC-012 are closed fail-safe by removing ImageMagick and PDFium production registrations. Restore those formats only through packaged per-RID worker processes with hard memory, CPU, output, and wall-clock limits; cancellation must terminate the worker and untrusted documents must never execute in the desktop process.
acceptance_criteria: TIFF/HEIC/PSD/RAW and PDF previews run only in bounded killable workers on every supported RID; timeout and resource-exhaustion fixtures terminate the worker without affecting the desktop process; packaging, legal closure, and the full repository gate pass.

title: Separate application-security keys from user credential vault
description: The dedicated ApplicationSecurityVault and ordinary credential vault both use the macOS service app.ghostshell. Broad credential metadata enumeration can therefore include app encryption keys/startup pepper; Global+UserManagement operations may expose them to credential-management flows. Moving services without migration would orphan keys and can brick encrypted profiles.
acceptance_criteria: Application-security material uses a distinct native-vault namespace. Existing config/cache/startup-protection keys migrate atomically from the legacy service without data loss or lockout. Ordinary credential listing and management cannot enumerate, relabel, replace, resolve, or delete reserved security references. Cross-platform migration and failure-path tests pass.

title: Replace Process Monitor sort selector with sortable headers
description: Remove the Process Monitor sort ComboBox and expose the supported process sorts through clickable table headers with File Viewer-style arrow indicators and accessible labels.

title: CEF startup rejects development profile link
description: Launching the macOS development bundle exits during embedded Chromium startup with: Browser profile storage contains an unexpected filesystem link. Diagnose the exact link and preserve fail-closed handling for unsafe profile roots while accepting/removing legitimate CEF artifacts.
acceptance_criteria: The macOS development bundle starts with a legitimate existing CEF profile tree. Unsafe root/ancestor/reparse-point substitution still fails closed. Focused tests and the full repository gate pass.
notes: Root cause had two parts: CEF creates legitimate singleton/version symlinks inside its owned profile tree, and macOS Chromium requests the generic Chromium Safe Storage key even for GhostSHELL's ephemeral contexts. Fixed by deleting child links without following targets while rejecting a linked root, and by enabling Chromium's documented use-mock-keychain switch only when cache/session persistence is disabled. Exact macOS development bundle reached the running GUI; focused Browser tests passed 15/15; ./scripts/check.sh --full passed.

title: Implement deterministic repository quality and security gates
description: Add strict C# formatting and analyzers, deterministic NuGet/tool inputs, repository-owned agent and Git hook gates, hardened CI, dependency/security scanning, coverage, mutation-test tooling, and release provenance. Bring first-party code to the enforced baseline without weakening existing behavior.
close_reason: Strict formatting, analyzers, dependency locks and audits, hooks, pinned CI, CodeQL, Dependabot, tool manifests, and a green canonical full gate are implemented.

title: Make the repository test gate deterministic
description: The pre-tooling baseline build succeeds, but solution-wide dotnet test runs project test hosts concurrently. Avalonia/global-state assemblies interfere, fixed localhost ports collide, and UI dispatcher tests fail nondeterministically. Define a deterministic test execution strategy and retain coverage/result collection without hiding real failures.
close_reason: The canonical gate now runs test projects sequentially with single-threaded xUnit configuration; repeated App-suite stress runs and the complete full gate pass.

title: Security audit and encryption-by-default hardening
description: Make application encryption enabled by default, run a full repository security audit, validate findings, remediate confirmed issues, and land all audit artifacts and fixes through the full quality gate.
notes: Completed current-state module audit and remediation. Encryption defaults on; 23 findings documented, 22 fixed, SEC-005 retained as ghostshell-6zt. Post-fix scanners retained zero candidates. Audit completion gate and ./scripts/check.sh --full pass. Follow-ups: ghostshell-6zt, ghostshell-909, ghostshell-4kq.

title: Vertically align runtime tab icons and titles
description: Optically align runtime tab icons with their title text across top, bottom, and side tab strip placements.
close_reason: Applied a one-DIP optical offset to shared runtime tab icons, added contract coverage, and verified rendered icon/title centers.

title: Add parallel GitHub CI and macOS early-release build
description: Partition the managed test suite into functional sections that run concurrently across supported CI hosts, preserve full cross-platform build and quality gates, and add a gated Apple Silicon macOS early-release package artifact for semantic version tags and manual runs.
close_reason: Added functional test-section parallelism across macOS, Linux, and Windows; preserved full platform builds; added a gated Apple Silicon early-release artifact; actionlint, focused section tests, and the full repository gate pass.

title: Align process monitor sortable headers with data columns
description: Remove gaps between sortable process monitor header cells while preserving the 8 px text inset and aligning each header label with its row values.
close_reason: Removed external gaps from sortable process headers, aligned labels to row content, added geometry contract coverage, and verified wide/narrow renders.
